{{Top|leg}}
'''Blink''', also known as Swerve, was a classic game known to children, thrill-seekers, and military tacticians across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

Every culture had its own version of Blink. The game followed the same basic rules: two [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], military vehicles, or athletes would speed directly toward one another in a dangerous contest of nerve. If neither turned aside, the result could be catastrophic—ranging from severe damage to outright mutually assured destruction. Typically, one participant would veer away at the last possible instant, making the other the winner.<ref name="conviction" />
